notes.ngenda: I am going (sasa) au I go (kila siku).

guidebook.intro: Kuuliza mahali, kutoa maelekezo na kusafiri kwa matatu au boda boda.

tips.title: “Where is…?”
body: **…iko wapi?** ni **Where is…?** Neno la swali huja mwanzoni: **Where is the bank?**
Majibu: **It’s near the church.** (Iko karibu na kanisa.) **It’s far.** (Iko mbali.) **It’s here.** (Iko hapa.)

tips.title: “I am going to…”
body: **Ninaenda mjini** ni **I am going to town.** Tumia **to** kabla ya mahali: **to school**, **to the market**.
Lakini **home** haichukui **to**: **I am going home.** Kuuliza: **Where are you going?** (Unaenda wapi?)

culture.title: Matatu, daladala, boda boda
body: Maneno haya ya Kiswahili hutumika hata kwa Kiingereza cha Afrika Mashariki: **I took a matatu to town.** Mgeni anaweza kusema **minibus** au **motorbike taxi**.
